pf.license.need: none checked by Rosie: hypnotherapy has no state license in most places; a certificate or membership is the practitioner's own word, optional, and never checked (D96)
pf.license.who: the business, for any registration or membership it chooses to show; each practitioner's certificate is their own word
pf.license.ask: optional: a registration number or a certificate the business wants shown; nothing is asked of each practitioner
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never checks a license, certificate, membership or insurance for this work
pf.license.certificates: a hypnotherapy certificate or a membership is shown as the practitioner's own word, never as a license
pf.license.blocks: nothing: no license or certificate blocks a booking here
pf.license.renewals: none checked; a date on a certificate is only a reminder the business sets itself
pf.license.insurance: professional liability insurance is optional: the business's own word; shown only if the business chooses
pf.license.background: any background check is the business's own policy, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.claims: no medical or mental-health claims: hypnotherapy is offered for habits, sleep, stress and confidence, never as treatment, a cure or a diagnosis

pf.services.shape: one-to-one sessions of 50 minutes, with a practitioner the client picks or any free one; video sessions; packs of sessions; a home or office visit
pf.services.examples: the example business's own prices (Lee Hypnosis Studio and Lee Hypno Visits), not a standard

list.after: at the front desk, or on the bill

pf.services.travel: a home or office visit is included inside the 25-mile area (the example's setting); a travel fee for farther towns where Sam sets one
pf.services.capacity: one practitioner per session; a two-person session needs two practitioners free at once; a group is one booking with several people
pf.services.skills: hypnotherapy for habits, sleep, stress and confidence; relaxation; only practitioners with the training a booking names are offered
pf.services.online: video sessions are a booking like any other; the video link is on the secure page
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the client must be there for a home or office session

beforeTimes: what the client wants to work on, in their own words (a habit, sleep, stress, confidence)
in the studio, by video, or at a home or office
a practitioner by name, or a woman or a man, only if the client asks
for a teen (16 or 17): the age; a parent or guardian books
afterTime: at a home or office: parking, the room, and a quiet space with a chair and a door that closes
anything the client would like the practitioner to know before the first session, in their own words
securePage: 18 or older, or 16 or 17 with a parent or guardian's consent on the page
the intake form: current goals, epilepsy, a recent head injury, a psychosis diagnosis, medicines, alcohol or drugs, and any care from a doctor or counselor
for a teen: the parent's consent, and that the parent waits on site
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult, for themselves or another adult; a parent or guardian for a 16 or 17 year old, who waits on site; no one under 16 (the example's setting)

stop.words: thoughts of harming yourself or someone else, or a crisis right now
stop.say: Please call or text 988 now, or call 911 if you're in danger. A session can't help with a crisis, so nothing is booked.

stop.words: a seizure, fainting, chest pain, trouble breathing, or hearing voices that tell someone to act
stop.say: This could be an emergency. Call 911 now. A session can wait.

stop.words: epilepsy, a recent head injury, or a psychosis diagnosis
stop.say: Please check with your doctor first. Hypnotherapy waits until a doctor says it's OK, in writing, on this page.
stop.booking: no booking until a doctor says it's OK, in writing

refuse.words: a request for sexual services, or to be touched in a sexual way
refuse.say: This practice offers hypnotherapy sessions only. This request can't be booked.
refuse.what: the exact words go to the business's safety log; Sam picks: refuse and block that chat or number, or it was innocent and a session may be booked (every later message is checked again); no reply in 2 of Sam's text hours: nothing is booked

goOn.words: a headache or a stiff neck
goOn.what: the practitioner moves to a quieter chair or a shorter session; the session goes on
the visit moves with no fee

pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency or self-harm → call 911 or 988, and no booking

steps.name: Intake form
steps.when: on the secure page before the first session (due when booking, inside the saved 10 minutes); a returning client confirms or updates it by the day before
steps.goodFor: 12 months, or until the client's health or goals change
steps.result: most answers change nothing; a flag (epilepsy, a head injury, a psychosis diagnosis, a doctor's care) goes to the practitioner to read before the booking is kept

steps.name: Practitioner's read of a flag
steps.when: before the booking is written, in the practitioner's text hours; no answer in 1 hour: Sam reads it
steps.result: OK as booked; OK with a note (a shorter session, no eye closing); a doctor's OK in writing first; or no, with the reason kept private

steps.name: A teen's consent
steps.when: on the secure page, from the parent or guardian who books
steps.result: the parent shows an ID at check-in and waits on site

pf.first_steps.prep: come 5 minutes early; eat lightly; tell the studio on the secure page about any change in health or medicines; at home or in an office: a quiet room with a chair and a door that closes

pf.visit.checkIn: at the studio: the check-in code at the front desk; at a home or office: the code at the door, from the client who booked; by video: the link on the secure page
pf.visit.beforeWork: the practitioner goes over the intake and what the client wants with the client before starting; the client can stop at any time, and can open their eyes, speak or leave the room
pf.visit.changes: a take-home audio or a longer session is priced and OK'd before it's done
pf.visit.stop: the practitioner may end a session that crosses a line and leave the room; Sam decides any charge (only what the client agreed to) and any block; it goes in the safety log
pf.visit.away: only practitioners Sam allows go to homes or offices; the practitioner's DONE is the check-out: no DONE 15 minutes after the booked end, Rosie texts, then calls the practitioner, then tells Sam with the address
pf.visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the practitioner; the practitioner's notes (goals, what was worked on) go in the client's private record

pf.money.before: at the studio: a card saved for the $60 late-cancel and no-show fee; a 6-session pack paid in full when bought; by video: a card saved for the $60 fee and charged at DONE; at a home or office: a card saved for the $80 fee, or a home session paid in full
pf.money.caps: no deposits are taken for hypnotherapy; the business's own fee is never more than what was paid now or what the card covers
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 24 hours before at the studio or by video, and until 8pm the evening before for a visit at a home or office (the owner's settings)
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: $60 at the studio or by video; $80 at a home or office; a pack session used up if Sam confirms; Sam confirms each fee, never more than what was agreed; a late arrival keeps the time booked at full price
pf.money.conduct: a session ended for the client's conduct: charged only what the booking page said, and only if Sam says so
pf.money.packs: packs of sessions and gift cards: sold at the studio, or on the secure page where Sam turns it on; a visit uses one session
pf.money.tips: off: hypnotherapy takes no tips on the bill
pf.money.tax: a tax line where the state's rules tax the service
pf.money.insurance: none: the business bills no health plan or insurance

pf.messages.never: the reason for a visit, goals, health answers, medicines, a doctor's note and the practitioner's notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's private record
pf.messages.tone: no words in any text that could read as medical care, therapy for a mental-health condition, a cure or a diagnosis; a session is offered for habits, sleep, stress and confidence
pf.messages.minors: a teen's booking texts go only to the parent or guardian; Rosie never texts the teen

pf.staff.licenses: no state license for hypnotherapy in most places; a certificate or membership is each practitioner's own word, shown only if they choose; never checked by Rosie (D96)
pf.staff.skills: hypnotherapy for habits, sleep, stress and confidence; relaxation and take-home audio; only practitioners with the training a booking names are offered
pf.staff.gender: each practitioner's gender is set only so a client can ask for a woman or a man; a filter used only when the client asks
pf.staff.supervision: a student works only with a named practitioner in the room, where the business sets it (none in the example)
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs same-day sessions and new clients at the studio; he can set every home or office visit to ask him first; a health flag goes to the booked practitioner, then to Sam after 1 hour
pf.staff.standIn: a stand-in must fit what the client asked (a woman, if asked) and the training booked, and gets the intake and notes
pf.staff.away: only practitioners Sam allows are offered for homes and offices

pf.rules.showLicense: no license claim on listings, times or confirmations; the business's own registration shows only if it has one
pf.rules.draping: not applicable: nothing is done to the body; the client keeps their clothes on and sits in a chair
pf.rules.hours: no sessions in hours the business has not set (the example's own hours)
pf.rules.away: home and office visits only inside the 25-mile area, and only where Sam allows the practitioner
pf.rules.minors: a parent or guardian's written consent on the secure page for a 16 or 17 year old, and a parent waiting on site
pf.rules.reset: 10 minutes between clients to reset the room (the example studio's setting)
pf.rules.records: intake forms and session notes kept 7 years, kept private

pf.edges.improper: a request for sexual services: refused, logged and sent to Sam (pf.safety)
pf.edges.lateArrival: the session ends on time at full price; at the studio, no word 15 minutes after the start is a no-show
pf.edges.runsLate: the practitioner runs late: the client keeps the full time if the next booking and the 10-minute reset still fit; if not, a new time with no fee
pf.edges.standIn: a stand-in who fits what the client asked and the training booked, with the intake and notes; or new times with no fee
pf.edges.healthChange: a new change in health or medicines before the session: the client updates the intake; the practitioner decides; a move has no fee
pf.edges.conduct: a session ended for the client's conduct: Sam decides any charge (only what was agreed) and any block
pf.edges.awaySafety: the safety check-out after visits at a home or an office
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
